# Native C PhysCal / Lanczos references (issue #181)

Generated by `c_toolbox/physcal_native/` from the vendored mVMC 1.3.0 `vmc.out`
(Linux x86_64 Dev Container, GCC 13.3, one rank). `scenarios.tsv` lists each
scenario; `<scenario>/` holds the inputs and fixed `zqp_opt.dat` that were run,
`expected/` the C `zvo_*` outputs (zero-byte files kept), `native-state/` the
per-sample saved configurations, `Counter[0..6]`, RNG draw count and next 624
words from the additive probe build, `time-rows/` the deterministic columns of
`zvo_time_*` and `provenance.txt`. `_sources/` holds hand-written inputs.
See `docs/reference/c-to-julia/verification/issue-181-physcal-lanczos-matrix.md`.
Rust tests read these files only; they never build or run C.
